name: Squirt Original Grapefruit Soda (12-Pack)
description: Crisp, tart, and wildly refreshing. Light, fizzy, caffeine-free naturally flavored grapefruit soda made with real citrus juice. Perfect ice-cold from the can or mixed in an authentic Mexican Paloma.

name: Squirt Zero Sugar Grapefruit Soda (12-Pack)
description: All the bright, bold citrus punch of classic Squirt with zero calories and zero sugar. Crisp hydration that satisfies intense thirst without any sugar crash.

name: Squirt Ruby Red Citrus Soda (2-Liter)
description: Bursting with sweet, tangy ruby red grapefruit flavor and a splash of citrus zest. Ideal for family cookouts, taco fiestas, and party punch bowls.

name: Squirt Paloma Cocktail Party Pack
description: The quintessential authentic mixer bundle for craft Palomas. Includes two 12-packs of Squirt, artisanal chili-lime cocktail salt, and recipe card for the perfect Mexican Paloma.
